card.name: Diluent names in dilution instructions
card.fires_on: The end of 'Sodium Chloride' (the 'ide' piece) in diluent lists for injections, and the gap or unit right before a volume or the word Injection in preparation tables.

modes.label: Sodium Chloride diluent
modes.description: The final piece of 'Chloride' in '0.9% Sodium Chloride Injection' when naming a diluent.

modes.label: Dilution table spacing
modes.description: The space or unit between amounts and the next item in a mixing table or ingredient list.
